sentence: Ur tetturareḍ ara yes-i, aql-ik deg ufus-iw!
credits: Sentence from Tatoeba by Igider (CC-BY 2.0 FR)
translations: Don't mess with me, I've got you!

usageExamples: Ur zmireɣ ara ad t-xedmeɣ mebla ma iɛawen-iyi kra n yiwen.
